name: trustmycard-frontend
description: Trust My Card frontend — website, admin, wallet SDK

scripts.dev:website: node scripts/stop-dev.mjs website && TMC_ENV=development npm run dev -w @trustmycard/website
scripts.dev:marketing: node scripts/stop-dev.mjs marketing && TMC_ENV=development npm run dev -w @trustmycard/marketing
scripts.dev:website:reset: node scripts/stop-dev.mjs website && TMC_ENV=development npm run dev -w @trustmycard/website
scripts.dev:admin: node scripts/stop-dev.mjs admin && TMC_ENV=development npm run dev -w @trustmycard/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @trustmycard/admin && npm run lint -w @trustmycard/website && npm run lint -w @trustmycard/marketing
